parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to display from the response. Pages start from page 1.

parameters.name: FirmwareId
parameters.description:
The ID of the firmware, which uniquely identifies the firmware.

The firmware ID is one of the parameters returned when you call [CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~) to create a firmware.

You can also call [ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~) to view the firmware ID from the response.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID is available on the **Overview** page, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of upgrade batches to display per page in the response. Maximum value: 200.
